system.description: A single page of the debt-book, listing names you do not recognise. Once per day, a creature that owes you anything (a coin, a favour, its life) must answer one question truthfully. Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: Write a name on it and burn it: one debt you owe that person (coin, favour or blood) is forgiven as if it had never been.
system.drawback: Whoever finds it now holds your debts. Someone will come to collect.
